mil5.1.1:1.1: Atha kho Milindo rājā katāvakāso nipacca guruno pāde sirasi añjaliṃ katvā etad-avoca:
mil5.1.1:1.2: Bhante Nāgasena, ime titthiyā evaṃ bhaṇanti:
mil5.1.1:1.3: yadi Buddho pūjaṃ sādiyati na parinibbuto Buddho, saṃyutto lokena antobhaviko lokasmiṃ lokasādhāraṇo, tasmā tassa kato adhikāro vañjho bhavati aphalo;
mil5.1.1:1.4: yadi parinibbuto, visaṃyutto lokena nissaṭo sabbabhavehi, tassa pūjā na uppajjati, parinibbuto na kiñci sādiyati, asādiyantassa kato adhikāro vañjho bhavati aphalo ti. Ubhatokoṭiko eso pañho, n'eso visayo appattamānasānaṃ, mahantānaṃ yev' eso visayo, bhind' etaṃ diṭṭhijālaṃ, ekaṃse ṭhapaya, tav' eso pañho anuppatto, anāgatānaṃ Jinaputtānaṃ cakkhuṃ dehi paravādaniggahāyāti. -
mil5.1.1:2.2: Parinibbuto mahārāja Bhagavā, na ca Bhagavā pūjaṃ sādiyati, bodhimūle yeva Tathāgatassa sādiyanā pahīnā, kim-pana anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbutassa.
mil5.1.1:2.3: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena Dhammasenāpatinā:
mil5.1.1:4.2: Bhante Nāgasena, putto vā pituno vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati pitā vā puttassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, na c' etaṃ kāraṇaṃ paravādānaṃ niggahāya, pasādappakāsanaṃ nām' etaṃ, ingha me tvaṃ tattha kāraṇaṃ sammā brūhi sakavādassa patiṭṭhāpanāya diṭṭhijālaviniveṭhanāyāti.
mil5.1.1:5.2: Parinibbuto mahārāja Bhagavā, na ca Bhagavā pūjaṃ sādiyati, asādiyantass' eva Tathāgatassa devamanussā dhāturatanaṃ vatthuṃ karityā Tathāgatassa ñāṇaratanārammaṇena sammāpaṭipattiṃ sevantā tisso sampattiyo paṭilabhanti.
mil5.1.1:6.1: Yathā mahārāja mahatimahāaggikkhandho pajjalitvā nibbāyeyya, api nu kho so mahārāja aggikkhandho sādiyati tiṇakaṭṭhupādānan-ti.
mil5.1.1:6.2: Jalamāno pi so bhante mahāaggikkhandho tiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ na sādiyati, kim-pana nibbuto upasanto acetano sādiyatīti. -
mil5.1.1:6.3: Tasmiṃ pana mahārāja aggikkhandhe uparate upasante loke aggi suñño hotīti. -
mil5.1.1:6.4: Na hi bhante, kaṭṭhaṃ aggissa vatthu hoti upādānaṃ, ye keci manussā aggikāmā te attano thāmabalaviriyena paccattapurisakārena kaṭṭhaṃ manthayitvā aggiṃ nibbattetvā tena agginā aggikaraṇīyāni kammāni karontīti. -
mil5.1.1:6.5: Tena hi mahārāja titthiyānaṃ vacanaṃ micchā bhavati: asādiyantassa kato adhikāro vañjho bhavati aphalo ti.
mil5.1.1:7.2: evam-eva Bhagavā dasasahassimhi lokadhātuyā buddhasiriyā pajjali;
mil5.1.1:7.4: evam-eva Bhagavā dasasahassimhi lokadhātuyā buddhasiriyā pajjalitvā anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbuto;
mil5.1.1:7.5: yathā mahārāja nibbuto aggikkhandho tiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ na sādiyati,
mil5.1.1:7.6: evam-eva kho lokahitassa sādiyanā pahīnā upasantā;
mil5.1.1:7.7: yathā mahārāja manussā nibbute aggikkhandhe anupādāne attano thāmabalaviriyena paccattapurisakārena kaṭṭhaṃ manthayitvā aggiṃ nibbattetvā tena agginā aggikaraṇīyāni kammāni karonti,
mil5.1.1:7.8: evam-eva devamanussā Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva dhāturatanaṃ vatthuṃ karitvā Tathāgatassa ñānaratanārammaṇena sammāpaṭipattiṃ sevantā tisso sampattiyo paṭilabhanti. Iminā pi mahārāja kāraṇena Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo
mil5.1.1:8.1: ti. Aparam-pi mahārāja uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ suṇohi yena kāraṇena Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo:
mil5.1.1:8.2: yathā mahārāja mahatimahāvāto vāyitvā uparameyya, api nu kho so mahārāja uparato vāto sādiyati puna nibbattāpanan-ti. -
mil5.1.1:8.3: Na hi bhante uparatassa vātassa ābhogo vā manasikāro vā puna nibbattāpanāya,
mil5.1.1:8.6: Api nu tassa mahārāja uparatassa vātassa vāto ti samaññā upagacchatīti. -
mil5.1.1:8.7: Na hi bhante, tālavaṇṭa-vidhūpanāni vātassa uppattiyā paccayā, ye keci manussā uṇhābhitattā pariḷāhaparipīḷitā te tālavaṇṭena vā vidhūpanena vā attano thāmabalaviriyena paccattapurisakārena vātaṃ nibbattetvā tena vātena uṇhaṃ nibbāpenti pariḷāhaṃ vūpasamentīti. -
mil5.1.1:8.8: Tena hi mahārāja titthiyānaṃ vacanaṃ micchā bhavati: asādiyantassa kato adhikāro vañjho bhavati aphalo ti.
mil5.1.1:9.2: evam-eva Bhagavā dasasahassimhi lokadhātuyā sītala-madhura-santa-sukhuma-mettāvātena upavāyi;
mil5.1.1:9.4: evam-eva Bhagavā sītala-madhura-santa-sukhumamettāvātena upavāyitvā anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbuto;
mil5.1.1:9.5: yathā mahārāja uparato vāto puna nibbattā panaṃ na sādiyati,
mil5.1.1:9.7: yathā mahārāja te manussā uṇhābhitattā pariḷāhaparipīḷitā,
mil5.1.1:9.9: yathā tālāvaṇṭa-vidhūpanāni vātassa nibbattiyā paccayā honti,
mil5.1.1:9.10: evam-eva Tathāgatassa dhātu ca ñāṇaratanañ-ca paccayo hoti tissannaṃ sampattīnaṃ paṭilābhāya;
mil5.1.1:9.11: yathā manussā uṇhābhitattā pariḷāhaparipīḷitā tālavaṇṭena vā vidhūpanena vā vātaṃ nibbattetvā uṇhaṃ nibbāpenti pariḷāhaṃ vūpasamenti,
mil5.1.1:9.12: evameva devamanussā Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva dhātuñ-ca ñāṇaratanañ-ca pūjetvā kusalaṃ nibbattetvā tena kusalena tividhaggi-santāpa-pariḷāhaṃ nibbāpenti vūpasamenti.
mil5.1.1:9.13: Iminā pi mahārāja kāraṇena Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo ti.
mil5.1.1:10.1: Aparam-pi mahārāja uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ suṇohi paravādānaṃ niggahāya:
mil5.1.1:10.2: yathā mahārāja puriso bheriṃ ākoṭetvā saddaṃ nibbatteyya, yo so bherisaddo purisena nibbattito so saddo antaradhāyeyya, api nu kho so mahārāja saddo sādiyati puna nibbattāpanan-ti. -
mil5.1.1:10.3: Na hi bhante, antarahito so saddo, na-tthi tassa puna uppādāya ābhogo vā manasikāro vā, sakiṃ nibbatte bherisadde antarahite so bherisaddo samucchinno hoti,
mil5.1.1:10.4: bheri pana bhante paccayo hoti saddassa nibbattiyā, atha puriso paccaye sati attajena vāyāmena bheriṃ ākoṭetvā saddaṃ nibbattetīti. -
mil5.1.1:11.1: Evam-eva kho mahārāja Bhagavā sīla-samādhi-paññā-vimutti-vimuttiñāṇadassana-paribhāvitaṃ dhāturatanañ-ca dhammañ-ca vinayañ-ca anusatthiñ-ca satthāraṃ ṭhapayitvā sayaṃ anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbuto, na ca parinibbute Bhagavati sampattilābho upacchinno hoti, bhavadukkhapatipīḷitā sattā dhāturatanañ-ca dhammavinayañ-ca anusatthiñ-ca pacca yaṃ karitvā sampattikāmā sampattiyo paṭilabhanti. Iminā pi mahārāja kāraṇena Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo ti.
mil5.1.1:12.2: kathitañ-ca bhaṇitañ-ca ācikkhitañ-ca. Siyā kho pan' Ānanda tumhākaṃ evam-assa: atītasatthukaṃ pāvacanaṃ, na-tthi no satthā ti; na kho pan' etaṃ Ānanda evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ, yo vo Ānanda mayā dhammo ca vinayo ca desito paññatto so vo mam' accayena satthā ti.
mil5.1.1:12.3: Parinibbutassa Tathāgatassa asādiyantassa kato adhikāro vañjho bhavati aphalo ti taṃ tesaṃ titthiyānaṃ vacanaṃ micchā abhūtaṃ vitathaṃ alikaṃ viruddhaṃ viparītaṃ, dukkhadāyakaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ apāyagamanīyan-ti.
mil5.1.1:13.1: Aparam-pi mahārāja uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ suṇohi yena kāranena Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo:
mil5.1.1:13.2: sādiyati nu kho mahārāja ayaṃ mahāpaṭhavī: sabbabījāni mayi saṃvirūhantūti. -
mil5.1.1:13.4: Kissa pana tāni mahārāja bījāni asādiyantiyā mahāpaṭhaviyā saṃvirūhitvā daḷhamūlajaṭā-patiṭṭhitā khandhasārasākhā-parivitthiṇṇā pupphaphaladharā hontīti. -
mil5.1.1:13.5: Asādiyantī pi bhante mahāpaṭhavī tesaṃ bījānaṃ vatthu hoti paccayaṃ deti virūhanāya, tāni bījāni taṃ vatthuṃ nissāya tena paccayena saṃvirūhitvā daḷhamūlajaṭā-patiṭṭhitā khandhasārasākhāparivitthiṇṇā pupphaphaladharā hontīti. -
mil5.1.1:13.6: Tena hi mahārāja titthiyā sake vāde naṭṭhā honti hatā viruddhā, sace te bhaṇanti:
mil5.1.1:13.7: asādiyantassa kato adhikāro vañjho bhavati aphalo ti.
mil5.1.1:14.1: Yathā mahārāja mahāpaṭhavī evaṃ Tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho,
mil5.1.1:14.2: yathā mahārāja mahāpaṭhavī na kiñci sādiyati evaṃ Tathāgato na kiñci sādiyati,
mil5.1.1:14.3: yathā mahārāja tāni bījāni paṭhaviṃ nissāya saṃvirūhitvā daḷhamūlajaṭā-patiṭṭhitā khandhasārasākhāparivitthiṇṇā pupphaphaladharā honti evaṃ devamanussā Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva dhātuñ-ca ñāṇaratanañ-ca nissāya daḷhakusalamūla-patiṭṭhitā samādhikkhandha-dhammasāra-sīlasākhā-parivitthiṇṇā vimuttipuppha-sāmaññaphaladharā honti. Iminā pi mahārāja kāraṇena Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo ti.
mil5.1.1:15.1: Aparam-pi mahārāja uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ suṇohi yena kāraṇena Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo:
mil5.1.1:15.2: sādiyanti nu kho mahārāja ime oṭṭhā goṇā gadrabhā ajā pasū manussā antokucchismiṃ kimikulānaṃ sambhavan-ti. -
mil5.1.1:15.4: Kissa pana te mahārāja kimayo tesaṃ asādiyantānaṃ antokucchismiṃ sambhavitvā bahuputtanattā vepullataṃ pāpuṇantīti. -
mil5.1.1:15.5: Pāpassa bhante kammassa balavatāya asādiyantānaṃ yeva tesaṃ sattānaṃ antokucciṃ kimayo sambhavitvā bahuputtanattā vepullataṃ pāpuṇantīti. -
mil5.1.1:15.6: Evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva dhātussa ca ñāṇārammaṇassa ca balavatāya Tathāgate kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo ti.
mil5.1.1:16.1: Aparam-pi mahārāja uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ suṇohi yena kāraṇena Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo:
mil5.1.1:16.2: sādiyanti nu kho mahārāja ime manussā: ime aṭṭhanavuti rogā kāye nibbattantūti. -
mil5.1.1:16.4: Kissa pana te mahārāja rogā asādiyantānaṃ kāye nipatantīti. -
mil5.1.1:16.6: Yadi mahārāja pubbe kataṃ akusalaṃ idha vedanīyaṃ hoti, tena hi mahārāja pubbe katam-pi idha katam-pi kusalākusalaṃ kammaṃ avañjhaṃ bhavati saphalan-ti.
mil5.1.1:16.7: Iminā pi mahārāja kāraṇena Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo ti.
mil5.1.1:17.1: Sutapubbaṃ pana tayā mahārāja Nandako nāma yakkho theraṃ Sāriputtaṃ āsādayitvā paṭhaviṃ paviṭṭho ti. -
mil5.1.1:17.2: Āma bhante, sūyati, loke pākaṭo eso ti. -
mil5.1.1:17.3: Api nu kho mahārāja thero Sāriputto sādiyi Nandakassa yakkhassa mahāpaṭhavīgilanan-ti. -
mil5.1.1:17.4: Ubbattiyante pi bhante sadevake loke, patamāne pi chamāyaṃ candimasuriye, vikirante pi Sinerupabbatarāje, thero Sāriputto na parassa dukkhaṃ sādiyeyya,
mil5.1.1:17.6: yena hetunā thero Sāriputto kujjheyya vā dusseyya vā so hetu therassa Sāriputtassa samūhato samucchinno, hetuno samugghātitattā bhante thero Sāriputto jīvitahārake pi kopaṃ na kareyyāti. -
mil5.1.1:17.7: Yadi mahārāja thero Sāriputto Nandakassa yakkhassa paṭhavīgilanaṃ na sādiyi kissa pana Nandako yakkho paṭhaviṃ paviṭṭho ti. -
mil5.1.1:17.9: Yadi mahārāja akusalassa kammassa balavatāya Nandako yakkho paṭhaviṃ paviṭṭho, asādiyantassāpi kato aparādho avañjho bhavati saphalo,
mil5.1.1:17.10: tena hi mahārāja kusalassa pi kammassa balavatāya asādiyantassa kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo ti.
mil5.1.1:17.11: Iminā pi mahārāja kāraṇena Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo ti.
mil5.1.1:18.1: Kati nu kho te mahārāja manussā ye etarahi mahāpaṭhaviṃ paviṭṭhā, atthi te tattha savanan-ti. -
mil5.1.1:18.4: Ciñcamāṇavikā bhante, Suppabuddho ca Sakko, Devadatto ca thero, Nandako ca yakkho, Nando ca māṇavako ti, sutaṃ
mil5.1.1:18.5: metaṃ bhante: ime pañca janā mahāpaṭhaviṃ paviṭṭhā ti. -
mil5.1.1:18.8: Api nu kho mahārāja Bhagavā vā sāvakā vā sādiyiṃsu imesaṃ mahāpaṭhaviṃ pavisanan-ti. -
mil5.1.1:18.10: Tena hi mahārāja Tathāgatassa parinibbutassa asādiyantass' eva kato adhikāro avañjho bhavati saphalo ti. -
mil5.1.1:18.11: Suviññāpito bhante Nāgasena pañho gambhīro tānīkato, guyhaṃ vidaṃsitaṃ, gaṇṭhi bhinnā, gahanaṃ agahanaṃ kataṃ, naṭṭhā paravādā, bhaggā kudiṭṭhi, nippabhā jātā kutitthiyā, tvaṃ gaṇivarapavaram-
